steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 29
steps.text: In this B2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: There's too much background noise to hear clearly.
Listen carefully to the announcement at the gate.
She has a strong Scottish accent.
